reason: An app with my salon's own name and logo, WhatsApp bills, automatic Google review requests and a live view of the chairs is exactly the modern look I want, and ₹500 a month is nothing for a salon my size. The second ₹5,000 is only paid if my stylists actually use it, so I'm not stuck with a dud.
objection: My senior stylists may feel the live chair view and the cash-drawer checks are me watching them, and if they drag their feet I'm the one who has to push it. I've also seen small local software outfits vanish after a year, so I worry about whether one person can really answer during Durga Puja rush.
would_change_my_mind: If another established Bhubaneswar salon told me the support person didn't pick up in a festival week, or my staff pushed back hard during the demo, I'd walk away.
